donation:person:it:
L’Associazione Voltare Pagina ETS, nella persona del suo rappresentante legale Lucilla Lucchese, dichiara di aver ricevuto da {donor}, quale erogazione liberale, la somma di {amount} ({amount_words}) in data {date}, con {payment_method}.

L’Associazione Voltare Pagina ETS è ente non commerciale iscritto nel RUNTS (Registro Unico Nazionale del Terzo Settore) di cui all’art. 45 del D.Lgs. 117/2017 e s.m.i., giusta determina n. G02400 del 5/3/2024.

Per le persone fisiche l’erogazione liberale è detraibile dall’imposta lorda nella misura del 30% fino a € 30.000 (art. 83 co. 1 del D.Lgs. 117/2017) o, in alternativa, deducibile nel limite del 10% del reddito complessivo dichiarato (art. 83 co. 2 del D.Lgs. 117/2017).

L’erogazione è stata effettuata con un sistema di pagamento tracciabile, condizione per la detraibilità o deducibilità prevista dalle norme.

La presente ricevuta è esente da imposta di bollo ai sensi dell’art. 82 co. 5 del D.Lgs. 117/2017.

donation:person:en:
Associazione Voltare Pagina ETS, through its legal representative Lucilla Lucchese, declares that it received from {donor}, as a donation, the sum of {amount} ({amount_words}) on {date}, by {payment_method}.

Associazione Voltare Pagina ETS is a non-commercial entity registered in RUNTS (the Italian National Single Register of the Third Sector) under art. 45 of Legislative Decree 117/2017 as amended, by determination no. G02400 of 5/3/2024.

The tax benefits below apply to taxpayers in Italy, under Italian law. This receipt is a translation; the Italian version prevails.

For individuals, the donation qualifies for a 30% tax credit up to €30,000 (art. 83(1) of Legislative Decree 117/2017) or, alternatively, a deduction of up to 10% of declared total income (art. 83(2) of Legislative Decree 117/2017).

The donation was made through a traceable payment system, a condition for the tax credit or deduction under the law.

This receipt is exempt from stamp duty under art. 82(5) of Legislative Decree 117/2017.

shipping:en: Associazione Voltare Pagina ETS acknowledges receipt from {donor} of {amount} on {date}, by {payment_method}, as reimbursement of the shipping costs for the thank-you gifts linked to donation {order}. This amount is not a donation and is not tax-deductible. Exempt from stamp duty under art. 82(5) of Legislative Decree 117/2017.

footer:en: Personal data linked to the donation are processed in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Legislative Decree 196/2003. The full privacy notice is available on the association’s official channels.
